A lethality item with health that blocks the next enemy ability that would hit you.

Stats

  • 50 Attack Damage
  • 15 Lethality

What it does

Annul: Grants a Spell Shield that blocks the next enemy Ability.

When to buy it

Buy it on attack-damage assassins and carries when an enemy stun or burst ability keeps stopping you.
